_doc: User-scope MCP servers for every project on this workstation. Applied by `claude-tooling-sync apply`, checked by `claude-tooling-sync verify` (also run by check-drift). Env values in ${VAR} form resolve from the session environment; secrets come from ~/.local/secrets (the age store), never from this file. Record every server here in the same session it is added; see ~/.claude/docs/claude-tooling.md.

svelte._why: Official Svelte team server: versioned Svelte 5 and SvelteKit 2 docs plus a static check of Svelte code. Every cairn-family site is SvelteKit.

playwright._why: Microsoft's Playwright server: structured DOM inspection for reproducing an e2e failure; distinct from claude-in-chrome, which drives the desktop browser. It defaults to a Chrome build at /opt/google/chrome, which this workstation lacks, so it points at the layered Chromium. The version is pinned to 0.0.85, the one measured in the stack-pilots pass, so a new release changes nothing until a dependency upgrade moves it.
